records.notes: The witness saw only head and shoulders in the recorded position, did not see the gun then, saw no muzzle flash, and did not visually observe the actual shot.

appearances.snippet: But most crucially. He instantly immediately has maintained that that gun looks smaller than 30-06 and he tells me in other conversations that it looked like a 223. ... So that I would guess is probably the reason the prosecution did not want to call him forward. ... I'm guessing. A description doesn't go well with their fed sloppy narrative. And remember, I just want to remind you, in terms of that route going Losee Center over to the library, which she makes very clear that's the route that the shooter took, that that's why we thought we had to recover these items.
